sources.title: Dobrushin's ergodicity coefficient for Markov operators on cones
sources.actual_read: Full primary PDF retrieved via Exa (46949 extracted characters); read Introduction eqs(1)-(2), Theorem6.2 and Example6.3. Source prints arXiv:1307.4649v3, 1 Nov2014. Primary web-PDF rendering also opened to repair Exa inequality/mathematical extraction loss; eqs(1)-(2) explicitly read.
sources.supports: Exact Dobrushin contraction coefficient on zero-sum l1 subspace for stochastic matrices; transpose row-stochastic source convention to our column generator convention.
sources.transfer: For sufficiently small h, P=I+hA is stochastic. Pair-column overlap gives delta(P)=1-h*lambda(A), lambda(A)=min_i<j[Aij+Aji+sum_k!=i,j min(Aki,Akj)]. Time-dependent exponential bound is a direct finite-dimensional derivation in R10, not an explicit theorem attributed to this paper.
sources.novelty: Known coefficient; project-specific projected-sink absorption and code binding are current contribution.
